fusions.name: Prank Burst
fusions.desc: A sonic burst deals 3 dark damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, each with a 20% chance to turn on its allies for 3 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Cheap Shot
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 30% health for 20 dark damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to the hit. Until something has bled, it has 50% more critical chance. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Return to Sender
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lucky Flutter
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
